title: Gemini chat requests can include video
summary:
Gemini gained video input, Unity got a darker persona, and several API edge cases became less surprising.

Chat completions gained `video_url` content parts for Gemini models, so a message can pair a video URL with text for analysis. Video and image URL objects also accept an optional `mime_type`.

Unity’s persona was rewritten with a darker, mood-aware conversational style. It now directs visual requests to `generate_image` and keeps a consistent appearance for selfies. Its supernatural powers and memory are character fiction, not platform capabilities.

Image requests can handle unencoded reference-image URLs that contain their own query parameters, with guidance for invalid URLs. Veo polling now returns HTTP 400 for prompt or policy errors instead of reporting them as server failures.

highlights.title: Video input for Gemini
highlights.text: Send a `video_url` alongside text in a Gemini chat-completion request to ask questions about a video. The URL object can also include a `mime_type`. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Unity’s darker side
highlights.text: Unity has a darker, mood-aware conversational style and can use `generate_image` for visual requests, including selfies with a consistent appearance.
